title: Backpropagating Verifier Rewards Through Continuous Flow Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19080v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning of autoregressive and discrete-diffusion language models. Language models that generate continuous token embeddings are emerging as a strong alternative, but RL post-training for them remains understudied. We propose \method{}, a post-training framework for continuous flow language models. Such a model denoises token embeddings over multiple steps and decodes them into discrete tokens only at the last step. To obtain pathwise gradients, which backpropagate through continuous actions and have much lower variance than REINFORCE, we introduce a critic that estimates the value of intermediate token embeddings, bypassing the non-differentiable decoding step. The critic must also keep track of the value function as the policy changes; to this end, we design a critic that predicts a value from every token representation and improves policy optimization. translated_title: 通过连续流语言模型反向传播验证器奖励
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已显著提升了自回归和离散扩散语言模型的推理能力。生成连续词元嵌入的语言模型正成为一种强有力的替代方案，但针对这类模型的强化学习后训练研究仍然不足。我们提出了一个针对连续流语言模型的后训练框架。这类模型在多个步骤中对词元嵌入进行去噪，并仅在最后一步将其解码为离散词元。为了获得路径梯度——即通过连续动作进行反向传播且方差远低于REINFORCE的梯度——我们引入了一个评论家（critic）网络来估计中间词元嵌入的价值，从而绕过不可微的解码步骤。评论家还必须在策略变化时跟踪价值函数的变化；为此，我们设计了一个能够从每个词元表示预测价值的评论家网络，以改进策略优化。在四个推理任务上的实验表明……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 提出了一种面向连续流语言模型的强化学习后训练框架，通过引入估计中间词元嵌入价值的评论家网络，绕过不可微的解码步骤，实现验证器奖励沿连续动作的路径梯度反向传播，从而以更低方差提升模型推理能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a reinforcement learning post-training framework for continuous flow language models that backpropagates verifier rewards through continuous actions via a critic network estimating values of intermediate token embeddings, bypassing the non-differentiable decoding step to achieve much lower-variance policy optimization.
